why:
Items from Backpack Battles that this game will never have. Each one exists to put another class's items in the shop, and those classes are not being made, so there is nothing to build.

Nothing loads this file. It sits beside data/items/ rather than in it, because ConfigLoader globs data/items/*.json and an item in here must not reach the catalogue. It is kept rather than deleted because each one has effects besides the class unlock -- Wolf Badge's Battle Rage, Flame Badge's Heat -- so one could be brought back as a different item without being reconstructed from the wiki.

cog_badge.name: Cog Badge
cog_badge.why: Offers Engineer items, and there is no Engineer.
unbuilt: Engineer items are offered in the shop.
Items won't fuse when entering the shop.
Shop entered: Generate a Cog.
After 4s: Emit a charge, traveling 1 Lightning every 2s.
Items under the charge trigger 10% faster + 3% for each Lightning traveled.

Start of battle: Gain 6 Heat.
